body.statement: Kennedy's Gaussian-process and multiplier-bootstrap results for incremental propensity-score effects index the odds multiplier by a fixed compact set; those results do not cover a sequence of multipliers \(\delta_n\to\infty\).

source.locator: Corollary 2 and the fixed compact multiplier index set used for the Gaussian process and multiplier bootstrap
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 3, Assumption 1: The set D = [δ_l,δ_u] is bounded with 0 < δ_l ≤ δ_u < ∞. The estimator converges in ℓ∞(D) to a mean-zero Gaussian process; the multiplier bootstrap constructs uniform confidence bands across δ ∈ D.

attestation.note: Verified directly in the complete arXiv v3 PDF, Section 4.3 Theorem 3 (pp. 12–13) and Section 4.4. The bounded positive interval excludes any sequence δ_n→∞.
